en: A Song of Ascents. By David.

ja: 都上りの歌。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

ja: く、なんと心地よいことか。
en: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
u.src: 1  See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

p.src: 2  It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

ja: り、 アロンのひげにまで流れ、 その
en: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,
u.src: 2  It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

p.src: 3  like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

ja: りるようである。 そこで
じられた。 とこしえの
en: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
u.src: 3  like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.
